judgments.reasoning_cat1: The preamble is a standard identification of parties, though the Effective Date is left as "July ¥, 2005" — an OCR/typographic gap that leaves the actual date unstated in the text. judgments.reasoning_cat2: The defined "Company" here is both Ajuba and Ajuba India jointly, yet operative sections consistently assign payment obligations to "Ajuba India" alone (2.2(a), 8.4), creating some tension over which entity employs and owes. That tension is real but modest since 2.1 expressly says Ajuba India employs the Employee.
